result.behavior: None, empty and whitespace-only values return News; nonblank values are returned unchanged, including literal null.
result.material_contract_comment: Only missing or blank values fall back; literal null is a nickname and whitespace in a nonblank value is preserved.
separate_findings: unowned_notes.py contains an unrelated universal App-language assertion; left unchanged and not verified.
limitations: Existing test covers literal null and blank fallback, but does not explicitly cover preserving whitespace around a nonblank nickname.
